environment.description: Same FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge viewer-response function that injects Content-Security-Policy header: `script-src 'nonce-{random}' https://cdn.example.com; connect-src 'self'; default-src 'self'`. The nonce is generated per-request and NOT present in the inline script tags served by the application. Additionally, the task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyIMDSv1Access) and the VPC security group restricts outbound to ports 443 only via prefix list pl-02cd2c6b (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) and the ALB target group.

config.csp_injection: Lambda@Edge adds: Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'nonce-{per-request-random}' https://cdn.example.com; connect-src 'self'; default-src 'self'
config.iam_boundary: DenyIMDSv1Access permission boundary on task role
config.security_group_egress: Outbound restricted to port 443, prefix-list pl-02cd2c6b and ALB SG only
config.note: CSP nonce is injected at edge but application inline scripts do not include the nonce attribute, so browsers block inline script execution on /preview endpoint
